# Document Sync Issues

Now when I run Aspire Host and 3 CollaborativeTextEditor instances spawn, there's no documents. My guess is that because we introduced that each client has its own document store (I'm running on Windows btw).
When I create a new document in one of the running clients, and hit refresh in Document Session UI in other clients, no document is presented in Avaliable document section.

Also, after some typing in client in which I created a new document, I type few words and client crashes.

There are serious issues after last refactorings in run named 'demoapp-collaborativeeditor-issues-3-the-dem'.
